description:
The Huffy PAW Patrol Tilt 'N Turn Scooter brings rescue missions to life with colorful PAW Patrol graphics and a fun, kid-friendly design. Perfect for riders ages 3 and up, this kids scooter encourages active outdoor play and imaginative adventures.
The stable three-wheel design and Tilt 'N Turn steering help young riders build balance, coordination, and confidence with every ride. A durable steel frame, sturdy resin deck, and easy rear foot brake provide the control kids need as they learn.
Whether cruising the sidewalk or heading to the park, this PAW Patrol scooter is built for everyday adventures. Durable construction and confidence-building features help little riders explore, play, and create new rescue missions every day.

components.description: Easy Rear Foot Brake: Simple-to-use rear brake gives young riders reliable stopping power for confident control.
